description.value:
You know of a way to make use of your skin molts to create a remedy that helps protect you from injury and disease. Each day during your daily preparation, you take parts of your molt and brew it into an alchemical drink. Attempt a Crafting or Medicine check against a DC 20. If you become Master in Crafting or Medicine, you can attempt the check at a DC of 30, but increase the bonus you benefit from by 1. Only you can benefit from your own remedy.

@UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.ancestries.oOQGd01j7SVPcElk]{Effect: Molting Skin Remedy}

Critical Success You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks against Disease and Poison until your next daily preparations. If you suffer from persistent damage, reduce the flat check to end the condition to 12.

Success As critical success, but you do not reduce your flat check from persistent damage.

Failure As success, but the circumstance bonus is +1.
